name: Raffaele Mazziotti
summary: Associate Professor at the University of Florence. His work investigates numerical cognition, numerosity perception, multisensory processing and the links between perception, action and mathematical abilities.
research: His research focuses on how the human brain represents number, space and action. He combines psychophysics, developmental approaches and multisensory paradigms to study numerosity, attention and sensorimotor contributions to cognition.

teaching.text: Teaching information is maintained on the official University of Florence profile and course catalogue.

cv: Research activity on numerosity perception, attention and sensorimotor number cognition.
Member of Florence MAPLab and PisaVisionLab research networks.
topics: Current themes include perceptual and sensorimotor foundations of number cognition, developmental trajectories of mathematical abilities, visual attention and multisensory processing.
